overview:
Delaware's at-large House seat sits in territory that leans Democratic by about eight points, and incumbent Sarah McBride is seeking re-election with all the advantages that status brings. The resource imbalance in this race is extreme: McBride has raised roughly $5.1 million and holds $2.7 million on hand, while Republican Joseph Arminio has reported about $6,600 in total receipts. Outside spending in the race is negligible.

No public general-election polls or expert ratings are available, so the outlook rests on district fundamentals, the fundraising gap, and prediction markets, which price McBride's chances around 97%. With no sign of a competitive challenger operation, the seat is rated Safe Democratic, with an expected margin of victory in the neighborhood of twenty points.
